title: Fitness, predictability and equilibrium in biological dynamics
summary: Understanding eco-evolutionary dynamics presents significant mathematical challenges, particularly regarding predictability, equilibrium, and the mathematical representation of fitness. Using Open System Dynamics and Stochastic Analysis, we develop a theoretical framework to characterize fitness change and its relationship with predictability. We explore the limiting behavior of biomass abundances modeled by stochastic processes, deriving continuous-time diffusion counterparts from discrete-time models.
